#@title
def inspect_raw(craw,start, chan_sel,nchan=10,time_step=2,events=None):
    order = np.arange(nchan, dtype = int) + int(nchan*(chan_sel-1))
    order = order[order < len(raw.ch_names)]
    cfig = craw.plot(events = events, start = start, duration = time_step,
                     order = order,show_scrollbars = False)

def raw_interact(craw, time_step = 2, nchan = 10, events=None):
    _ = widgets.interact(inspect_raw,
                     craw = widgets.fixed(craw),
                     nchan = widgets.fixed(nchan),
                     time_step = widgets.fixed(time_step),
                     events = widgets.fixed(events),
                     start = widgets.FloatSlider(value = 0,min = 0,max = raw.times[-1], step = time_step, description = 'time'),
                     chan_sel = widgets.FloatSlider(value = 1, min = 1,step = 1, max = int(np.ceil(len(raw.ch_names)/nchan)),description = 'chan group'))

import numpy as np
import mne

events = mne.find_events(raw_ref, stim_channel="Status")

target_conditions = [11, 12, 13, 14]

cond_mapping = {
    11: 62,
    12: 63,
    13: 64,
    14: 65
}

cond_events_list = []

current_condition = None
has_41_since_condition = False

for sample, _, code in events:

    # new condition starts
    if code in target_conditions:
        current_condition = code
        has_41_since_condition = False

    # participant stopped balloon
    elif code == 41 and current_condition is not None:
        has_41_since_condition = True

    # trial marker: only keep if 41 happened before it
    elif code == 61 and current_condition is not None:

        if has_41_since_condition:
            cond_events_list.append([
                sample,
                0,
                cond_mapping[current_condition]
            ])

        current_condition = None
        has_41_since_condition = False

cond_events = np.array(cond_events_list)

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import mne
from mne.stats import spatio_temporal_cluster_1samp_test

# Get data: shape (n_epochs, n_channels, n_times)
data = epochs["non_social_ai"].get_data()
evoked = epochs["non_social_ai"].average()

# Time window of interest
tmin, tmax = 0.25, 0.33
time_mask = (evoked.times >= tmin) & (evoked.times < tmax)
times_of_interest = evoked.times[time_mask]

# Slice data to time window: (n_epochs, n_channels, n_times_window)
data_win = data[:, :, time_mask]

# spatio_temporal_cluster_1samp_test expects (n_obs, n_times, n_channels)
X = data_win.transpose(0, 2, 1)

# Build adjacency matrix from channel positions
adjacency, _ = mne.channels.find_ch_adjacency(evoked.info, ch_type="eeg")

# Run cluster permutation test
t_obs, clusters, cluster_pv, H0 = spatio_temporal_cluster_1samp_test(
    X,
    adjacency=adjacency,
    n_permutations=1000,   # increase to 5000+ for publication
    threshold=dict(start=0, step=0.2),   # TFCE (no arbitrary t threshold)
    tail=0,                # two-tailed
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=True,
)

# --- Build significance mask (n_times_window, n_channels) ---
sig_mask = np.zeros(t_obs.shape, dtype=bool)   # shape: (n_times, n_channels)
for cluster, pv in zip(clusters, cluster_pv):
    if pv < 0.05:
        sig_mask[cluster] = True

# --- Plot topomaps for each time slice ---
time_indices_win = np.where(time_mask)[0]
plot_times = np.arange(0.25, 0.33, 0.02)
plot_tidx = [np.argmin(np.abs(times_of_interest - t)) for t in plot_times]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(plot_tidx), figsize=(3 * len(plot_tidx), 3))
if len(plot_tidx) == 1:
    axes = [axes]

for ax, ti in zip(axes, plot_tidx):
    # mask for this time point: shape (n_channels,)
    mask_t = sig_mask[ti, :]

    evoked.plot_topomap(
        times=[times_of_interest[ti]],
        ch_type="eeg",
        units="µV",
        scalings=1e6,
        time_unit="s",
        contours=0,
        axes=ax,
        show=False,
        mask=mask_t,
        mask_params=dict(
            marker="o",
            markerfacecolor="w",
            markeredgecolor="k",
            linewidth=0,
            markersize=4,
        ),
    )

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import numpy as np
import mne
from mne.stats import permutation_cluster_test
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats


# feedback-locked epochs, already baseline corrected
# epochs["loss"], epochs["win"] should work

frn_chs = ["Fz", "FCz", "Cz"]
tmin, tmax = 0.0, 0.6

social = epochs["social"].copy().pick(frn_chs).crop(tmin, tmax)
non_social  = epochs["non_social"].copy().pick(frn_chs).crop(tmin, tmax)

# average over FRN channels, keep trials x time
X_social = social.get_data().mean(axis=1)   # shape: n_loss_trials x n_times
X_non_social  = non_social.get_data().mean(axis=1)    # shape: n_win_trials x n_times

times = social.times

n1 = X_social.shape[0]
n2 = X_non_social.shape[0]
df = n1 + n2 - 2

p_threshold = 0.05
t_threshold = -stats.t.ppf(1 - p_threshold, df)
# For FRN, loss is expected to be more negative than win
# So test loss < win. Use tail=-1.
T_obs, clusters, cluster_pvals, H0 = permutation_cluster_test(
    [X_social, X_non_social],
    n_permutations=5000,
    threshold=t_threshold,
    tail=-1,
    out_type="mask",
    seed=42,
    n_jobs=1
)

# Plot difference wave
loss_erp = X_social.mean(axis=0)
win_erp = X_non_social.mean(axis=0)
diff = loss_erp - win_erp

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.plot(times, loss_erp * 1e6, label="Loss")
plt.plot(times, win_erp * 1e6, label="Win")
plt.plot(times, diff * 1e6, label="Loss - Win", linewidth=2)
plt.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)
plt.axvline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)

# mark significant clusters
for cluster, pval in zip(clusters, cluster_pvals):
    if pval < 0.05:
        plt.axvspan(times[cluster][0], times[cluster][-1], alpha=0.3)

plt.xlabel("Time from feedback onset (s)")
plt.ylabel("Amplitude (µV)")
plt.title("Single-subject FRN cluster permutation test")
plt.legend()
plt.gca().invert_yaxis()

plt.show()

print("Significant clusters:")
for cluster, pval in zip(clusters, cluster_pvals):
    if pval < 0.05:
        print(f"{times[cluster][0]:.3f}–{times[cluster][-1]:.3f} s, p = {pval:.4f}")

import numpy as np
import mne
from mne.stats import permutation_cluster_test
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats


# feedback-locked epochs, already baseline corrected
# epochs["loss"], epochs["win"] should work

frn_chs = ["Fz", "FCz", "Cz"]
tmin, tmax = 0.0, 0.6

social = epochs["social"].copy().pick(frn_chs).crop(tmin, tmax)
non_social  = epochs["non_social"].copy().pick(frn_chs).crop(tmin, tmax)

# average over FRN channels, keep trials x time
X_social = social.get_data().mean(axis=1)   # shape: n_loss_trials x n_times
X_non_social  = non_social.get_data().mean(axis=1)    # shape: n_win_trials x n_times

times = social.times

n1 = X_social.shape[0]
n2 = X_non_social.shape[0]
df = n1 + n2 - 2

p_threshold = 0.05
t_threshold = -stats.t.ppf(1 - p_threshold, df)
# For FRN, loss is expected to be more negative than win
# So test loss < win. Use tail=-1.
T_obs, clusters, cluster_pvals, H0 = permutation_cluster_test(
    [X_social, X_non_social],
    n_permutations=5000,
    threshold=t_threshold,
    tail=-1,
    out_type="mask",
    seed=42,
    n_jobs=1
)

# Plot difference wave
loss_erp = X_social.mean(axis=0)
win_erp = X_non_social.mean(axis=0)
diff = loss_erp - win_erp

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.plot(times, loss_erp * 1e6, label="Loss")
plt.plot(times, win_erp * 1e6, label="Win")
plt.plot(times, diff * 1e6, label="Loss - Win", linewidth=2)
plt.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)
plt.axvline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)

# mark significant clusters
for cluster, pval in zip(clusters, cluster_pvals):
    if pval < 0.05:
        plt.axvspan(times[cluster][0], times[cluster][-1], alpha=0.3)

plt.xlabel("Time from feedback onset (s)")
plt.ylabel("Amplitude (µV)")
plt.title("Single-subject FRN cluster permutation test")
plt.legend()
plt.gca().invert_yaxis()

plt.show()

print("Significant clusters:")
for cluster, pval in zip(clusters, cluster_pvals):
    if pval < 0.05:
        print(f"{times[cluster][0]:.3f}–{times[cluster][-1]:.3f} s, p = {pval:.4f}")

import numpy as np
import mne
from mne.stats import permutation_cluster_test
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

colors = {
    "social": "#FA5252",
    "non_social_ai": "#74C0FC",
    "social_ai": "#C77DCE",
    "non_social": "#ADB5BD"
}
# feedback-locked epochs, already baseline corrected
# epochs["loss"], epochs["win"] should work

frn_chs = ["FCz"]
tmin, tmax = 0.0, 0.6

non_social  = epochs["non_social"].copy().pick(frn_chs).crop(tmin, tmax)

# average over FRN channels, keep trials x time

X_non_social  = non_social.get_data().mean(axis=1)    # shape: n_win_trials x n_times

times = non_social_ai.times

n1 = X_non_social_ai.shape[0]
n2 = X_non_social.shape[0]

# So test loss < win. Use tail=-1.

    [X_non_social_ai, X_non_social],
    n_permutations=5000,

)

plt.axvline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)

# mark significant clusters
for cluster, pval in zip(clusters, cluster_pvals):
    if pval < 0.05:
        plt.axvspan(times[cluster][0], times[cluster][-1], alpha=0.3)

plt.xlabel("Time from feedback onset (s)")
